verdict.rationale: The only first-party sign of native automation is a single word, "workflows", in Cal.com's capability list (docs-28). Beyond that, follow-ups depend on external tooling: a Zapier app that fires on booking created, rescheduled, cancelled or meeting ended (intdir-7), and booking-lifecycle webhooks (docs-5). Nothing shows built-in timed email/SMS reminder sequences. Missing for 10: documented native email/SMS reminder sequences, configurable timing before or after meetings, SMS support evidence, no-show reduction evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
